decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model dental consumable with its own web page, it fits the firm's core laboratory offering and is unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly.
This thermoforming blank is close to the firm's established dental materials business and its standalone presentation suggests enough strategic importance to keep it on the market.
The lacquer fits the workflow portfolio but its weaker website presence than the main launches makes it somewhat more at risk than the core products.
An intraoral contrast spray supports digital dental workflows, matching the firm's innovation direction, and its own product page indicates active commercial support.
Custom earmolds are well aligned with the firm's hearing-care capabilities, and even with limited web prominence they are part of a strategically relevant product family.
Custom hearing protection earmolds use the same custom-manufacturing strengths as the hearing business, though their somewhat more niche positioning raises withdrawal risk modestly.
